only_changed_leaves.before: Wide establishing view from a walled London garden in 1666, one middle-aged English householder with a short beard and receding hairline, wearing a plain knee-length coat, appears head to toe as a small figure on the left and points over the wall toward a distant orange fire glow beyond narrow gabled rooftops; an intact brick house stands beside the garden under a soft overcast sky
only_changed_leaves.after: Wide establishing view from a walled London garden in 1666, one adult English householder in his thirties with mature facial features and a plain knee-length coat appears head to toe as a small figure on the left, pointing over the wall toward a distant orange fire glow beyond narrow gabled rooftops; an intact brick house stands beside the garden under a soft overcast sky
